MID1-selected player/region is temporarily bound into the still-canonical JSON session; no PostgreSQL context row or credential issuance is introduced in I1.

assessment: No new source/backend fact requires a Pass337 Design loopback. I1 remains bounded: client compatibility plus ingress/auth perimeter only; I2/I3 responsibilities are not pulled forward.
